summary: AAP rejects MCP requests such as job stdout with HTTP 406 when the output is not JSON; ask the AI tool to request JSON and convert it afterwards.
questions: Why does the Ansible MCP server return 406?
How do I get job stdout through the MCP server?

answer_card.title: MCP 406 errors
answer_card.answer_md: AAP returns **406** when the MCP server asks for non-JSON output (for example job stdout). Tell the AI tool to request **JSON**, then convert it to the format you want.
